text: The University of Texas at Dallas School of Economic, Political and Policy Sciences offers the Bachelor of Arts in International Political Economy under the 2024-2025 Catalog. The degree plan form records Student Name, UTD ID, Double Major/Degree, Admit Term, Minor, and Advisor, and marks admission type as FTIC, Transfer, or Other.
source_title: Bachelor of Arts in International Political Economy, 2024-2025 Catalog

text: Minimum GPA Requirement: 2.0 in the major and 2.0 overall. Minimum of 120 total semester credit hours, and a minimum of 45 upper-level semester credit hours, to complete the degree.
source_title: Bachelor of Arts in International Political Economy, 2024-2025 Catalog

text: Incoming freshmen must enroll and complete requirements of EPPS 1110. EPPS 1110 is Critical Issues in the Social Sciences (Freshman Seminar).
source_title: Bachelor of Arts in International Political Economy, 2024-2025 Catalog

text: Core Curriculum: 42 semester credit hours. Curriculum requirements can be fulfilled by other approved courses from institutions of higher education. The courses listed are recommended as the most efficient way to satisfy both Core Curriculum and Major Requirements at UT Dallas.
source_title: Bachelor of Arts in International Political Economy, 2024-2025 Catalog

text: A required major preparatory course that also fulfills a Core Curriculum requirement has its semester credit hours counted in the Core Curriculum. Communication, Mathematics, Life and Physical Sciences, Language, Philosophy and Culture, Creative Arts, and American History are chosen from the approved dropdown lists. Two courses are required in Communication, Life and Physical Sciences, and American History.
source_title: Bachelor of Arts in International Political Economy, 2024-2025 Catalog

text: Government/Political Science: GOVT 2305 and GOVT 2306. Social and Behavioral Sciences: ECON 2301. Component Area Option: ECON 2302. Methods of Quantitative Analysis in the Social and Policy Sciences is chosen from the approved dropdown list. ECON 2301, ECON 2302, and the quantitative analysis course are required major preparatory courses that also fulfill Core Curriculum requirements.
source_title: Bachelor of Arts in International Political Economy, 2024-2025 Catalog

text: Major Core Courses: 12 semester credit hours. Choose 4 out of the following 8 courses.
source_title: Bachelor of Arts in International Political Economy, 2024-2025 Catalog

text: The Global Economy, GEOG 3370. World Resources and Development, IPEC 3349. Political Economy of Industrialized Countries, IPEC 4301. Political Economy of Developing Countries, IPEC 4302.
source_title: Bachelor of Arts in International Political Economy, 2024-2025 Catalog

text: Politics of International Finance, IPEC 4377. Global Politics, PSCI 4329. International Political Economy, PSCI 4356. Political Economy of Multinational Corporations, PSCI 4360.
source_title: Bachelor of Arts in International Political Economy, 2024-2025 Catalog

text: International Political Economy Electives: 24 semester credit hours. See https://epps.utdallas.edu/current-students/undergraduate-advising/ for the list of approved courses.
source_title: Bachelor of Arts in International Political Economy, 2024-2025 Catalog

text: Area Electives: 12 semester credit hours. See https://epps.utdallas.edu/current-students/undergraduate-advising/ for the list of approved courses.
source_title: Bachelor of Arts in International Political Economy, 2024-2025 Catalog

text: Foreign Language Requirement: 12 semester credit hours of the same language. Students can petition the Program Head for exceptions. If the language credit is obtained without taking classes, twelve additional semester credit hours of free electives, upper-division or lower-division, can be taken by the student.
source_title: Bachelor of Arts in International Political Economy, 2024-2025 Catalog

text: Elective Requirements: 18 semester credit hours. This requirement may be satisfied with lower- and upper-division courses from any field of study.
source_title: Bachelor of Arts in International Political Economy, 2024-2025 Catalog
